page.notes: Layout is three index columns with a centred "FINIS" below; the small numerals at the left of entries are verse numbers and are kept with their lines. Doubtful readings, with no [?] marked because the scan is legible but small: "effetis" (possibly "essetis"), "cotaminauerunt" in Apocalypse 14 (the print may read "coinquinauerunt"), "pafcant", and the Greek "συμ- πρεσβύτερος" in the 1 Peter entry, where the print is faint. The 1 Peter line "Renati fumus nō ex femine mortali" is joined from "mor-" and "tali" without a printed hyphen. Page numbers and references in the right-hand columns are printed as shown; the "33.b" and "227.a" figures are read from small type.
